targets.rawSql: SELECT recorded_at AS time, scenario AS metric, sum(hourly_usd * hours)::double precision AS value FROM cost_scenarios WHERE source = 'estimate' AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT occurred_at, action, resource_id, mode, result FROM audit_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 100
